title: The Four Seasons
seo_title: Year 1 Science: The Four Seasons Worksheets (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter)
standard_text: Observe changes across the four seasons. Observe and describe weather associated with the seasons and how day length varies.
meta_desc: Free Year 1 science worksheets on the four seasons: the order of the seasons, months, signs of each season in nature, what to wear and temperature through the year. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Spring, summer, autumn and winter, then spring again.
body_html:
How to think about it

There are four seasons in a year.

  • Spring, summer, autumn, winter.
  • Each season has different weather.
  • Plants and animals change with the seasons.
Example

Which season comes after summer?

Leaves fall next

Answer: autumn

Example

Frost on the grass. Which season?

Coldest season

Answer: winter

Common mistakes

  • Thinking spring comes after summer.
  • Thinking December is in autumn.
  • Thinking leaves fall in spring.

faq.a: Spring, summer, autumn and winter. They come in the same order every year.

faq.q: Which months are in each season in the UK?
faq.a: Spring: March, April, May. Summer: June, July, August. Autumn: September, October, November. Winter: December, January, February.

faq.q: How do plants and animals change with the seasons?
faq.a: In spring there is blossom and baby animals; in summer lots of green leaves; in autumn leaves fall and squirrels store nuts; in winter many trees are bare and some animals hibernate.
